parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located on the side of the toaster, typically used to start or cancel the toasting process.
parts.Functional_description: It activates or stops the heating mechanism when pressed, controlling the toasting cycle.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Slider
parts.Basic_description: A plastic lever or slider on the side of the toaster used to lower the bread into the slots.
parts.Functional_description: It engages the internal mechanism to start the toasting process and hold the bread down.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns upward automatically after toasting.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the toaster made of stainless steel, housing the heating elements and internal mechanisms.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support, heat insulation, and protection for internal components.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.
